threads.body: `SystemInstructionPart` does not yet mirror the pinned semconv model: it reuses this package's `GenericPart`, which requires a `value` field and cannot preserve arbitrary provider-specific properties at the top level, while the pinned model declares only `type` and allows arbitrary extra properties. As a result, provider parts must be reshaped as `{"type": ..., "value": ...}` rather than represented as specified. Please introduce a representation that preserves the model's property shape and cite `gen-ai-system-instructions.json`, as required by the [util-genai semantic-model rule](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python-genai/blob/main/.github/instructions/util-genai.instructions.md#2-semantic-conventions).

Please redesign the collection contract so existing hook implementations remain valid, then make every example use that exact protocol signature.

threads.body: This conversion now silently discards every non-text system-instruction part. Google’s `GenerateContentConfig.system_instruction` accepts `ContentUnion`, which includes `Content`, individual `Part` values, and lists of parts, while the new semconv union includes `GenericPart` specifically for non-text/custom system parts. Map non-text parts to an appropriate `GenericPart` discriminator instead of omitting them from telemetry.

Apply the same transitional `list[SystemInstructionPart] | list[MessagePart]` annotation and deprecation note to the fetch-response invocation.
